title: Only Razorpay's open and cancelled answers are ever checked against the real payment company
what: The one cloud check that talks to a real payment company covers Razorpay only, and only a link that is opened and then cancelled, plus wrong keys. Cashfree, PayU and PhonePe, which owners can also connect, are only ever tested against a pretend company, even though two of them take amounts in rupees instead of paise. A paid, expired, failed or refunded answer is never checked against any real company.
expected: Before payments go live, every company an owner can connect is checked in its test mode, including a paid link (amount read back equal to the amount asked) and an expired or refunded one.
who: gym owners and members once payments go live
fix_line: Add the same test-mode check for Cashfree, PayU and PhonePe, and cover a paid and an expired link
